description: Medium: transform JSON with python stdlib.
prompt: Using only python stdlib (no installs, no network), read work/term-04/input.json (shape: {"users": [{"name": ..., "score": ...}, ...]}) and write work/term-04/output.json as a JSON object with exactly two keys: "names" (alphabetically sorted list of the user names) and "total" (sum of the scores as a number). Example shape: {"names": ["amy", "bob"], "total": 20}. The output must be valid JSON.
title: JSON transform with python
